For relational evidence, resolve routing and polarity before combining channels; list unresolved dependencies instead of intersecting marginal candidate sets. Before changing a diagnosis, identify the purchased evidence and causal relation that warrants the change. Retain uncertainty when that relation is unresolved. Return compact JSON; keep the rationale to at most three sentences.
